sections.title: What Data We Collect
sections.text:
a) Information you provide directly:
When using a contact form or emailing us, we may collect:
- Your name
- Email address
- Phone number

We do not collect sensitive personal data (e.g., health, racial, biometric information).

sections.title: Legal Basis for Processing
sections.text:
We process your data based on:
- Consent — when you accept cookies or submit your contact details
- Legitimate Interest — for website analytics and improvement
- Legal Obligation — if required to comply with the law

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
sections.text:
- To respond to your inquiries
- To monitor usage trends and detect technical issues
We do not use your data for direct marketing or share it with advertisers.

sections.title: Data Sharing and Transfers
sections.text:
We do not sell or rent your personal data.
Your data may be processed by trusted third-party providers (e.g., Google) that operate under data processing agreements compliant with GDPR. If data is transferred outside the EU, it is done under appropriate safeguards (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses).

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.text:
We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described above:
- Contact form submissions: up to 12 months

sections.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
sections.text:
As a data subject in the EU/EEA, you have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Rectify incorrect data
- Request deletion (“right to be forgotten”)
- Restrict or object to processing
- Data portability
- Withdraw consent at any time
- Lodge a complaint with your local Data Protection Authority
To exercise your rights, contact us at: kalyannaviesd@gmail.com

sections.title: Security Measures
sections.text: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data, including HTTPS encryption and access controls. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated “Effective Date” at the top.
